snippet.title: [RF Online Next] Meet the Biosuit : Arbiter
snippet.description:
Introducing the Arbiter!

An entity that determines life and death on the battlefield, the Arbiter specializes in both close- and mid-range combat across all directions. Wielding Force blades in a dizzying vortex of blazing knives, it sweeps across the battlefield, especially demonstrating explosive power in concentrated attack missions.

Deal lethal attacks to enemies with a furious whirlwind of Force blades—experience the Arbiter biosuit's combat capabilities today!
